tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for signing up for the study. I'd like to ask you some questions about your experiences with fashion and clothing. First, do you enjoy shopping for clothes or is it something you find tedious, why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢您报名参与这项研究。我想问您几个关于时尚和服装方面经历的问题。首先，您喜欢买衣服，还是觉得这件事很无聊？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. When you buy new clothes, what matters most to you: comfort, price, or style? Please explain why.
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。当你买新衣服时，你最看重的是什么：舒适度、价格，还是款式？请说明原因。
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Fair enough. How do you decide what to wear each day? Do you choose your clothes in the morning or the night before?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有道理。您每天如何决定穿什么？您是早上现选衣服，还是前一天晚上就选好？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Got it, and finally, some people believe that fashion trends change too quickly and that spending money on new fashions is wasteful. Do you agree or disagree with this viewpoint? Why or why not?
tasks.analysis: 中文：明白了。最后一个问题，有些人认为时尚潮流变化太快，把钱花在追逐新时尚上是浪费。您同意还是不同意这个观点？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview
